name: Molecular and Cell Biology PhD
summary: The Department of Molecular and Cell Biology admits PhD students for the fall only. First-year students complete three 10-week lab rotations before choosing a thesis adviser.

deadlines.label: Application deadline
deadlines.note: The page says 11:59:59 pm Eastern Time on November 19, 2026. Letters and all other documents must arrive by then too; late applications are not accepted.

timeline.interviews: Applicants invited to interview are contacted by mid-January. In-person interviews are January 31 to February 2 or February 21 to 23, 2027.
timeline.decisions: Offers are made from late February through mid-March 2027; all decisions are final by mid-March.

english.toefl: 5, with Speaking and Writing 4.5 (tests from 21 Jan 2026); 90 (tests from 1 Jun 2025 to 20 Jan 2026)
english.note: IELTS tests from 21 January 2026 also need Speaking and Writing 6.5. Tests taken before 1 June 2025 are not accepted, and neither is Duolingo. Not needed with a degree from a country where English is the main language, a degree from an accredited English-language US institution, or a year of full-time study at a US university with grades of B or better.

applicationFee.note: $135 for US citizens and permanent residents and $155 for everyone else, plus a 4.22% payment processing fee. Waivers are for US citizens and permanent residents with financial need or from eligible programs.

documents: Names of 1 to 3 faculty whose research interests you
requirements.note: Admission also depends on faculty interviews. You don't have to contact faculty before applying. Review starts as soon as your file is complete, so applying early is encouraged.

funding.note: Five and a half years of support for all students in good standing, including international students: a yearly funding guarantee plus all fees and non-resident tuition. Fees cover health and dental insurance.

international.note: International students were 12% of the class that started in 2025.
